questions.questionText: The diagram below shows the cost and revenue curves for a pizza in a popular high street restaurant. The restaurant currently pursues an objective of revenue maximisation. Refer to the previous diagram. There is a reduction in the demand for pizza. Ceteris paribus, which one of the following will happen to the restaurant’s average revenue and marginal revenue as a result of this change?
options: Average revenue and marginal revenue both fall
Average revenue and marginal revenue stay the same
Average revenue falls and marginal revenue increases
Average revenue increases and marginal revenue falls

questions.questionText: In March 2019, 458 054 new car registrations were made, which subsequently fell by 44% in March 2020 due to the impact of the global health crisis. Demand for new vehicles can change quickly and can be caused by a variety of factors. Which one of the following factors may cause a shift in demand for new cars?
options: Advertising
Cost of production
Indirect taxes
Subsidy to producers

questions.questionText: In March 2019, 458 054 new car registrations were made, which subsequently fell by 44% in March 2020 due to the impact of the global health crisis. Demand for new vehicles can change quickly and can be caused by a variety of factors. The diagram on the previous page shows new car registrations in March from 2007 to 2023. Using 2010 as the base year, calculate the index number for 2023.
With reference to Extract C, explain how incentives to use reusable coffee cups may lead to a fall in demand for single‑use cups.
Using examples from the information provided, explain what is meant by both ‘substitutes’ and ‘complementary goods’.

Disney+ is a streaming service that distributes films and television series produced by the Walt Disney Studios. Ceteris paribus, the most likely consequence of the above data is that Disney+ will experience an increase in its:
options: fixed costs
income elasticity of demand
price elasticity of demand
revenue

questions.questionText: Disney+ is a streaming service that distributes films and television series produced by the Walt Disney Studios. Draw a supply and demand diagram to show the likely effect of the change in the number of subscribers on the market equilibrium for Disney+ services.

Cobalt is a key metal used in the batteries of electric cars. China is the world’s largest producer of electric cars but has recently cut subsidies to its manufacturers. The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) produces more than 60% of the world’s supply of cobalt, from its small-scale mines. Many new small mines opened in 2018 as a result of improved expectations of profit. The following graph shows the price of cobalt between June 2018 and June 2019. With reference to the information provided, draw a supply and demand diagram to show why the price of cobalt fell between June 2018 and June 2019.

HS2 is a high-speed rail network linking the north and south of England. HS2 will be four years late and cost double the Department for Transport’s original estimate. The diagram below shows the demand for and supply of passenger rail services. The shift of the demand curve from D1 to D2 is most likely to result from a:
options: government decision to impose a tax on workplace parking
government decision to increase subsidies for rail travel
planned expansion of the government’s railway track building programme
reduction in the tax imposed on a litre of petrol

questions.questionText: With reference to Figure 2, examine two possible factors which may have influenced demand for rail travel since 2008.

The consensus that diesel emissions are bad for health has led to many cities planning to ban diesel vehicles from their centres. The mayors of Paris, Mexico City, Madrid and Athens have said they intend to ban these vehicles by 2025. Annotate the diagram to show the change in consumer surplus in the market for diesel vehicles, following the change in demand caused by the proposed 2025 ban in some city centres.

The consensus that diesel emissions are bad for health has led to many cities planning to ban diesel vehicles from their centres. The mayors of Paris, Mexico City, Madrid and Athens have said they intend to ban these vehicles by 2025. A ban on diesel vehicles in city centres will reduce the demand for diesel fuel. This is because:
options: consumers are irrational
consumers expect the price of diesel to rise
the goods are complements
the goods are substitutes

questions.questionText: The consensus that diesel emissions are bad for health has led to many cities planning to ban diesel vehicles from their centres. The mayors of Paris, Mexico City, Madrid and Athens have said they intend to ban these vehicles by 2025. Define the term ‘demand’.

The average fee charged by high-street estate agents to homeowners for selling property is 1.3% of the final sale price. In August 2016 the Office for National Statistics reported that the average house price in London was £489 000, whereas in the North East of England it was £127 000. Explain one likely reason for the difference in average house prices between London and the North East of England.
The following graph shows the global sales of personal computers (PCs) between 2011 and 2015. The percentage decrease in sales of PCs between 2011 and 2015 is:
The following graph shows the global sales of personal computers (PCs) between 2011 and 2015. Explain one likely reason for the decrease in sales of PCs.
With reference to the information provided and your own knowledge, evaluate the microeconomic and macroeconomic effects of increased UK demand for coffee at branded coffee shops.

The table shows market data for e-cigarette kits. The original equilibrium price is £23. As a result of a successful advertising campaign, demand increased by 3 000 e-cigarette kits at all prices. At the same time production costs fell leading to an increase in supply of 1 000 e-cigarette kits at all prices. Calculate the new equilibrium price and quantity following the successful advertising campaign and the fall in production costs. Use the last two columns for your working.
Explain why ‘bans on tobacco advertising’ (Extract A, line 7) may result in a decrease in the revenue of tobacco firms. Include a supply and demand diagram in your answer.

A restaurant in London offers an “all you can eat buffet for £8.99”. At this price you can refill your plate as many times as you like. With reference to the statement above explain what is meant by ‘diminishing marginal utility’.

A restaurant in London offers an “all you can eat buffet for £8.99”. At this price you can refill your plate as many times as you like. If the price of an “all you can eat buffet” fell from £8.99 to £6.99, which one of the following is likely to happen?
options: There is an extension in demand
The demand curve shifts to the left
The supply curve shifts to the left
There is a contraction in demand
